authored.title: هل كنتَ / كنتم
authored.explanation_ar: نسأل عن الحالة أو المكان الماضي مع you باستخدام were لا was.
authored.explanation_en: Use Were you to ask about someone's past state or location.
authored.contrast_ar: Were you happy? للسؤال الماضي؛ Are you happy? للحاضر.
authored.contrast_en: Were agrees with you in a normal past-state question. Did you asks about an action and needs a base verb.

plan.form: I went + to + place / I went home
plan.title: ذهبتُ

authored.form: I went + to + place / I went home
authored.title: ذهبتُ
authored.explanation_ar: went هي صيغة الماضي من go، ولا نقول goed. نقول went home دون to؛ أما went to the house فتتضمن to لأن house اسم مكان عادي.
authored.explanation_en: Use went, the past form of go, for a completed trip. Home is used without to after go/went in went home.
authored.contrast_ar: I went yesterday للماضي؛ I go every day للعادة.
authored.contrast_en: Went is the irregular past of go. Use to before most destination nouns, but not before home in went home.

authored.explanation_en: Use didn't plus the base verb to negate a past action.

authored.contrast_en: Didn't carries the past tense; the following verb stays in its base form. Compare didn't go with the affirmative went.
